summary.text: Fairshake is a U.S. super PAC funded mainly by cryptocurrency companies and investors, including Coinbase, Ripple and Andreessen Horowitz. Together with its affiliates Protect Progress and Defend American Jobs, it spent roughly $195 million in the 2024 cycle supporting pro-crypto congressional candidates and opposing others. It reported a $193 million war chest at the end of 2025 ahead of the 2026 midterms.

sources.title: Crypto PAC Fairshake touts $193 million war chest as regulatory bill faces first vote
How tech bros bought 'America's most pro-crypto Congress ever'

facts.claim: In 2024, crypto industry PACs directed about $40 million at defeating Senate Banking Committee Chair Sherrod Brown in Ohio, largely through Fairshake's affiliate Defend American Jobs. Fairshake itself spent over $10 million on ads against Rep. Katie Porter in California's Senate primary.

facts.claim: In the 2024 cycle, Fairshake and its affiliated PACs were funded mainly by crypto companies. Coinbase gave more than $75 million, and Ripple Labs and Andreessen Horowitz were among the other primary contributors.

connections.claim: Andreessen Horowitz was one of Fairshake's primary contributors in the 2024 cycle and gave a further $24 million in the second half of 2025.
